name: Sentry Bridge
subtitle: Sentry traffic in any EFB
description: Shows traffic from a uAvionix Sentry or Sentry Plus in EFB apps other than ForeFlight. The Sentry's Compatibility Mode sends traffic in a raw form; Sentry Bridge decodes it and sends standard GDL90 traffic reports to the EFB, on this device or another one. Advisory information only.

apps.name: Sentry Bridge
apps.subtitle: Sentry traffic in any EFB
apps.localizedDescription: Shows traffic from a uAvionix Sentry or Sentry Plus in EFB apps other than ForeFlight. The Sentry's Compatibility Mode sends traffic in a raw form; Sentry Bridge decodes it and sends standard GDL90 traffic reports to the EFB, on this device or another one. Advisory information only.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Receive Sentry flight data and EFB announcements over WiFi, and forward GPS, traffic and weather to the EFB address you select.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: GPS check keeps comparing this device's position with the Sentry's while the bridge runs in the background, and warns when they disagree. The position stays on this device: it is never stored, never sent to the EFB and never changes ownship or traffic data.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: GPS check compares this device's position with the Sentry's and warns on screen when they disagree. The position stays on this device: it is never stored, never sent to the EFB and never changes ownship or traffic data.
